attchmntText: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Astec LifeSciences Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Astec LifeSciences Limited has submitted their response.
voiceSummary: Astec LifeSciences Limited responded to National Stock Exchange of India Limited notice NSE/CM/Surveillance/17777 dated 9th November, 2026, regarding a significant increase in the trading volume of its securities. The company confirmed compliance with Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Astec LifeSciences stated there are no developments requiring mandatory disclosure under the Listing Regulations or the Securities and Exchange Board of India Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015. The company assured the exchange of continued adherence to regulatory obligations and appropriate disclosures as required. Tejashree Pradhan, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the reply on behalf of Astec LifeSciences Limited on 11th November, 2026.
